topic.source_contract: marine plan area, jurisdiction, activity, licence or exemption, assessments, consultation, decision, conditions, implementation and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A marine plan policy map is not treated as a marine licence.
A submitted application is not treated as a validated application.
Validation is not treated as licence approval.
A licence is not treated as satisfaction of all terrestrial or wildlife consents.
An exemption notification is not treated as permission where exemption conditions are unmet.
An EIA screening opinion is not treated as a completed environmental statement.
A granted licence is not treated as completed or compliant marine works.
No score or promotion is written without exact coordinates, jurisdiction, licence, other consents, implementation and monitoring evidence.
row_checks: Correct English marine plan area required
Inshore, offshore, tidal river and mean high water limits required
Deposit, removal, construction, dredging or cable activity required
Legal applicant and responsible operator required
Exact works polygon and route required
Licence, exemption and excluded activity distinguished
Current MMO engagement and advice required
Validated application and fee acceptance required
Screening, scoping and environmental statement required where applicable
Habitats assessment and mitigation required where applicable
Statutory consultees and public consultation required
Grant, refusal or variation decision required
Method, timing, monitoring and reporting conditions required
Planning, harbour, wildlife and Crown Estate permissions required
Map, policy or strategy alone is not exact-site delivery
Application or proposal is not approval
Funding announcement is not completed delivery
Current operational use or service required
